text:
jules_infra: Heads up: Savings Plan utilization alert for us-west-2 GPU SKUs. 30d utilization dropped from ~78% -> ~49%. Renewal window in ~45 days, risk of ~28% wasted commit if we don't act.

maria_fin: ouch. do we have the raw numbers? which SKUs + dollar impact?

jules_infra: quick snapshot from the cost query — see below. rough delta is ~$62k/mo at current rates if we keep current commit and utilization keeps falling.

jules_infra: ```
SKU      | avg_util_30d | avg_util_90d | committed_hours | used_hours_30d | gap_hours_30d
p4d.24xlarge | 0.51         | 0.77         | 18,000          | 9,180          | 8,820
g5.48xlarge  | 0.48         | 0.73         | 14,400          | 6,912          | 7,488
Total gap est $/mo ~ 62,000
```

leo_sre: Confirming — we spun up a few transient training clusters in us-west-2 last month for batch experiments, might explain the dip. Some jobs were migrated to eu-west-1 which increased regional imbalance.

anita_ops: I found three orphaned tag groups: `project:research`, `temp:exp-jan`, `ad-hoc-training`. They account for ~3.2k used_hours (mostly g5). I can scrub or reclass them if we want.

maria_fin: Can we reassign some of the committed capacity cross-region (us-west-2 -> eu-west-1) or is there a contract restriction?

jules_infra: Savings Plan is zonal/region-specific for these SKUs due to instance-family coverage. We can’t move the committed SKU, but we can: 1) refactor workload placement to use us-west-2 more, 2) sell/modify commitments (partial exchange) before renewal, or 3) intentionally let a chunk lapse and reduce next commit.

billingbot: Automated alert: savingsplan-usw2-p4d utilization trend — 30d avg 51%, 7d avg 44%, projected utilization at renewal (45d) 40% ±6%. See link: https://billing.internal/reports/savings/usw2-p4d

devops_eng: Proposal: short-term runway actions — (A) pause non-critical ad-hoc jobs scheduled in us-west-2 for 2 weeks, (B) migrate queued batch jobs to spot in eu-west-1 for 30 days, (C) run a tag cleanup and reassign projects to cost centers. I can implement A+C starting today.

leo_sre: +1 to A and C. For B we need to check data residency for a couple customers — I'll flag if any blocked jobs.

maria_fin: If we can recover ~5k hours in us-west-2 before renewal that's ~ $13k/mo saved. Good interim win.

anita_ops: I'll start the tag scrub now and post the list of terminated/retagged instances.

jules_infra: I'll open a short-lived internal opt-in for teams running experiments: move non-prod runs to eu-west-1 or delay. @leo_sre can you help communicate?

leo_sre: Yep will ping the ML teams and add a small blurb in #devex.

maria_fin: Also please run a commitment exchange options run — how many hours we can convert/downgrade w/o penalty? That analysis should be done within 7 days to inform renewal commit.

jules_infra: On it. I'll post updated numbers in this thread by EOD tomorrow.

devops_eng: Quick note: if we choose to maintain current commit, consider enabling more aggressive auto-burst for dedicated pools to reduce wasted reserved capacity at the margin.

anita_ops: tag scrub started — rough ETA 4h, will attach CSV when done.

jules_infra: thanks all. action items: anita - tag scrub CSV, leo - comms + residency check, devops_eng - enable pool burst config, maria - run exchange options, jules - updated utilization projection tomorrow EOD. :clipboard: :hourglass_flowing_sand:

billingbot: Incidentally, renewal notice hits account billing console in 37 days.

maria_fin: noted. if anything material changes flag Finance ASAP.

jules_infra: last note — callout to the platform team: we should consider scheduling a quarterly commitment healthcheck dashboard so this doesn't blindside renewals. filing a doc request after triage.

leo_sre: 👍

anita_ops: CSV uploaded to #eng-infra-files: https://files.internal/eng-infra/1777770000-tag-scrub.csv

jules_infra: thread pinned for visibility. will update with the EOD projection.
